description: Three ring modulators in series, then a voltage-selected ring modulator, then a pair of switchable cross-modulators, ending in a soft clipper

params.text: Attenuates the ring input on that row before the offset knob beside it is added
Adds a direct voltage to that row's attenuated ring input; with the offset at maximum and nothing patched, that row passes the signal through
Steps the selector on to the next of the three voltage inputs below it
While held, flips the cross-modulation of the first output by the second
Flips the cross-modulation of the first output by the second on and off, one press at a time
While held, flips the cross-modulation of the second output by the first
Flips the cross-modulation of the second output by the first on and off, one press at a time

inputs.text: One of the two signals to be modulated, which comes out inverted by the first block
One of the two signals to be modulated
The signal for that row of the three cascaded ring modulators; an empty jack makes that row pass the signal through unchanged
A rising edge steps the selector on to the next of the three voltage inputs below it
One of three signals the selector picks between to ring-modulate both channels; the lamp beside the selector is red, green or blue for the one in use
A rising edge flips the cross-modulation of the first output by the second
A rising edge flips the cross-modulation of the second output by the first

outputs.text: The first channel after all three blocks, soft-clipped by a double arctangent
The second channel after all three blocks, soft-clipped by a double arctangent

notes: nothing comes out unless each of the three cascaded stages has a patched ring input or its offset turned up, because an empty stage with a closed offset multiplies by zero
the selector block is skipped entirely, and its button, its clock and its lamp do nothing, until at least one of its three voltage inputs is patched
output levels climb fast here, so watch the level and feed it material that is harmonically related, such as octaves
